BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Pierce Properties are delighted to present to the market No. 8 Greenacres, Donaghmore a lovely four-bedroom detached bungalow in one of County Wexford's most desirable coastal locations.
Set on a generous c. 0.42-acre site, this charming home offers the perfect escape from the pace of everyday life while remaining within easy reach of excellent local amenities. Just a short stroll from the beautiful Donaghmore Beach, the property also enjoys close proximity to Ballygarrett Village, the scenic Cahore Point, and is only a 15-minute drive from Gorey Town and the M11 motorway, making south Dublin accessible in approximately one hour.
The bright and spacious accommodation is perfect for comfortable family living. A welcoming entrance hallway leads to a bright and spacious triple-aspect living/dining room, flooded with natural light and offering ample space for entertaining. The dining area connects to the modern fitted kitchen, complete with integrated appliances, a feature extractor fan, and direct access to the rear garden.
The home boasts four generously proportioned bedrooms, each benefiting from its own walk-in wardrobe, while a well-appointed family bathroom completes the accommodation.
Outside, the property is surrounded by mature hedging and fenced boundaries and is laid mainly in lawn, offering plenty of space for outdoor living, family activities, or future landscaping opportunities.
Whether you're seeking a permanent family home, a coastal retreat, or a holiday residence, No. 8 Greenacres offers an enviable lifestyle in a truly exceptional location.
Viewing comes highly recommended to fully appreciate all this wonderful coastal home has to offer.
